svg.aria-label: Budgywell: Offline-first budgeting for Tunisia. FinTech · own product. Every change is written on the phone first, then synced as idempotent commands into an append-only, double-entry ledger guarded by Postgres row-level security. Stack: Flutter, Riverpod, drift, NestJS, Fastify, PostgreSQL. 703 commits, 285 test files, FR EN AR + Derja. The code is private.
